tools.name: list_france_calculators
tools.description: Free. Lists every available French tax and payroll calculator with its MCP tool name, price, input schema, example input, real example output and unsupported cases. Call it first if you are unsure which tool fits the user’s question.

tools.name: france_income_tax
tools.description: Computes French personal income tax (impôt sur le revenu, IR) for a tax household: number of tax shares (parts, quotient familial), gross tax on the official DGFiP progressive scale, family-quotient cap, décote, net tax payable, average rate and marginal rate (TMI). Income years 2024, 2025. Input: h

tools.name: france_micro_entrepreneur_contributions
tools.description: What a French micro-entrepreneur (auto-entrepreneur) pays to URSSAF for a month, quarter or year: social contributions (with or without ACRE), training contribution (CFP), chamber tax, optional flat-rate income tax (versement libératoire), net income. Years 2025, 2026. Optional: VAT franchise check

tools.name: france_gross_to_net_salary
tools.description: French private-sector gross-to-net salary (salaire brut → net), mainland France, 2026 rules, CDI or CDD, full-time or part-time (temps partiel): employee contributions, net pay, net taxable pay, optional tax withholding (prélèvement à la source), RGDU reduction, employer cost. For a CDD: end-of-cont

tools.name: france_working_days
tools.description: French public holidays (jours fériés) and working days for mainland France and Alsace-Moselle, 2000-2027: list a year's holidays, count calendar, working (jours ouvrés) and business days (jours ouvrables) between two dates, or add N working days to a date.
